Combat stance

Choose defensive or aggressive behaviour on the movement control.

Aggressive characters engage nearby enemies. Defensive behaviour gives you more control over engagement.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Aggressive/Defensive

Depending on the situation, you can put your character in one of two modes.

In Aggressive mode the character will automatically attack all enemies he sees.
In Defensive mode the character will not attack any enemies until you issue the command to attack a particular one.

To switch to one of these modes, use the (currently highlighted) control panel at the lower-left of the screen, or use the <A> key.

Note: you can assign any of these modes to any individual character.

Features

In Defensive mode the character will stop fighting after the enemy has been killed or after another command has been issued to him, such as "cast a spell" or "move to another location". To resume combat you'll need to issue an attack command again.

You can use this mode if the character needs to replenish stamina while there's an enemy nearby. A fighting character will not regenerate Stamina.
